sentences.en: Their pseudo-scientific rhetoric serves as justification for America's imperialist foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 他们伪科学的修辞为美国帝国主义的外交政策提供了借口。

sentences.en: Beauty is that marvelous mystery that neither psychology nor rhetoric deciphers.
sentences.zh: 美是那奇妙的奥秘，心理学和修辞学都无法破解。

sentences.en: Such rhetoric serves to announce his ideological affiliations.
sentences.zh: 这种雄辩术旨在宣布他的意识形态归属。
